description: Manage devices with Omnissa Workspace ONE UEM: find, lock, wipe, sync and message devices, install profiles and apps, manage enrollment users, and read smart groups and organization groups.

workspace_one_device_added_to_smart_grou.description: Runs when a device joins a smart group, because it was enrolled or now matches the group's rules. Devices already in it when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.device: The device as the smart group lists it.
output.id: The device's id, for 'Get device' and the other device actions.
output.name: The device's name.

parameters.description: The smart group to watch.
parameters.name: smart_group_id

workspace_one_device_compromised_trigger.description: Runs when Workspace ONE reports a device as compromised (jailbroken or rooted), among the newest 2,000 devices. Devices already compromised when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.compromised: True if it is reported jailbroken or rooted.
output.device: The whole device record as Workspace ONE gives it.
output.id: The device's id, for 'Get device', 'Lock device' and the rest.
output.name: The device's name in the console.
output.ownership: C (corporate dedicated), S (corporate shared) or E (employee).
output.platform: Its platform, such as Apple or Android.
output.username: The enrollment user it belongs to.

parameters.description: Only devices in this organization group and those under it. Choose one to start within seconds; leave empty for every device the connection can see.
parameters.name: organization_group_id

workspace_one_device_noncompliant_trigge.description: Runs when a device becomes non-compliant with your Workspace ONE compliance policies, and again if it falls out of compliance after being fixed. Devices already non-compliant when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.compromised: True if it is reported jailbroken or rooted.
output.device: The whole device record as Workspace ONE gives it.
output.id: The device's id, for 'Get device', 'Lock device' and the rest.
output.name: The device's name in the console.
output.ownership: C (corporate dedicated), S (corporate shared) or E (employee).
output.platform: Its platform, such as Apple or Android.
output.username: The enrollment user it belongs to.

parameters.description: Only devices in this organization group and those under it. Choose one to start within seconds; leave empty for every device the connection can see.
parameters.name: organization_group_id

workspace_one_new_app_trigger.description: Runs for each new app in Workspace ONE. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 2,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.app: The whole app as Workspace ONE lists it.
output.id: The app's id, for 'Install app on device' with its App type.
output.name: The app's name.

workspace_one_new_device_trigger.description: Runs when a device is enrolled in Workspace ONE, with its user, model, platform and organization group. Devices enrolled before the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.compromised: True if it is reported jailbroken or rooted.
output.device: The whole device record as Workspace ONE gives it.
output.id: The device's id, for 'Get device', 'Lock device' and the rest.
output.name: The device's name in the console.
output.ownership: C (corporate dedicated), S (corporate shared) or E (employee).
output.platform: Its platform, such as Apple or Android.
output.username: The enrollment user it belongs to.

parameters.description: Only devices in this organization group and those under it. Choose one to start within seconds; leave empty for every device the connection can see.
parameters.name: organization_group_id

workspace_one_new_profile_trigger.description: Runs for each new profile in Workspace ONE. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 2,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.id: The profile's id, for 'Install profile on device'.
output.name: Its name.
output.profile: The whole profile as Workspace ONE lists it.

workspace_one_new_smart_group_trigger.description: Runs for each new smart group in Workspace ONE. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 2,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.device_count: How many devices are in it.
output.id: The smart group's id, for 'List smart group devices'.
output.name: Its name.
output.smart_group: The whole smart group as Workspace ONE lists it.

workspace_one_new_user_trigger.description: Runs for each new user in Workspace ONE. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.active: True if the user is active.
output.id: The user's id, for 'Get user' and the other user actions.
output.user: The whole user record as Workspace ONE gives it.

workspace_one_user_deactivated_trigger.description: Runs when an enrollment user is deactivated in Workspace ONE. Users already inactive when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.
